Name: CC - Molamole's Furniture Catalogue
Author: MolaMole
Description:
[center]
﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6py1HccS/00.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
Here is a [i]Molamole's Catalogue[/i] to gather Mole's furniture in one place ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ with few variants! - [b]It only change the esthetic of the Catalogue Furniture, the content is the same[/b] / you can't have more than one! -.
It's related to the following mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337]Molamole's Furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28667]Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35163]Molamole's Countertops & Cabinets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28460]Molamole's Pet Toys & Houses[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28380]Molamole's Nursery -Furnitures-[/url] (addon) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32333]Molamole's Bathroom[/url] (you need have the Catalogue to search, but at the same time need to download each mod regardless).

All no Furnitures -main purpose Decoration or esthetic- will go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35214]Molamole's old Catalogues[/url]﻿, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33634]Molamole's PlayGround[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34622]Molamole's Park Benches[/url] (no available, yet orz).

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][CC][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style A -[i] Mole's Choice[/i][/*]
[*][b][CC][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style B - [i]Modern[/i][/*]
[*][b][CC][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style C -[i]Classic[/i][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Where you can find it?][/size][/b]
[b]Robin Shop[/b] or -and beg you- [b]Krobus.[/b] 

[b][s][size=3][ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None (for now), leave a comment if there's any problem!


[center][size=2][b][size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b][/size][size=4][b]
You need to have [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿﻿] and [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] Mods
besides the Mod -[size=2][b][size=4][b][size=4][b]Furniture [/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size]Pack- like to have from Mole[/b][/size][/b][/size]
-[size=2][b]
Mole only upload Mods on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/][/url][size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size],
If you find them in other places, were submit without my knowledge
and I can't guarantee the safety of the file. 
Be careful there![/b][/size][/b][/size][/center]


[center][i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------[/i][/center]

[center]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4x5b8bgt/00.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center][url=https://i.postimg.cc/G2j12WMY/002.png]
[/url]﻿Aquí un catalogo para los muebles del topo, reunidos en un solo lugar ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ con algunos variantes! - [b]solo cambia la estetica del catalogo, el contenido es el mismo en las tres versiones / No puedes tener más de una versión![/b]-.[/center]
relacionado a los siguientes mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337]Molamole's Furniture[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28667]Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35163]Molamole's Countertops & Cabinets[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28460]Molamole's Pet Toys & Houses[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28380]Molamole's Nursery -Furnitures-[/url]﻿(addon por agregar) y [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32333]Molamole's Bathroom[/url] (es necesario tener el catalogo para buscar los muebles, así como tener cada paquete de inmobiliario descargado con sus consecuentes requisitos).

Todas las decoraciones -que no funcionen como muebles unicamente o principalmente- Iran en [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35214]Molamole's old Catalogues[/url]﻿, tales como [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33634]Molamole's PlayGround[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34622]Molamole's Park Benches[/url] [i](aun no disponibles orz).[/i]

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style A -[i] La selección topal[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style B - [i]Moderno[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/b][b]: [/b]Style C - [i]Clásico[/i][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Donde se encuentra?][/size][/b]
[b]La tienda de Robin[/b] -y por favor, lo sugiero encarecidamente-[b] Krobus. [/b]

[b][s][size=3][ Problemas conocidos ][/size][/s][/b]
Ninguno (por ahora), deja un comentario si encuentras alguno!


[center][size=4][b]IMPORTANTE:
[size=2][b][size=4][b]Son necesarios los mods [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿﻿] y [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]]
además de los Mods de la topa que quieras tener en el catalogo.[/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][size=3][size=3][b][b]
-[/b][/b][/size][/size]
[size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2]La Topa solo sube Mods en la página de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿!
Si los encuentras en otra página, fueron re-subidos sin mi conocimiento
y no puedo asegurar la integridad del archivo.
Tengan cuidado por allí![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/center]
